entities.name: María de la O Lejárraga
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: María de la O Lejárraga García was a Spanish feminist writer, dramatist, translator and politician. She is also known by her married name María Martínez Sierra. Some of her work was published under the name of her husband Gregorio Martínez Sierra.
